thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate for org SilverStream (org_4632). ~18% 5xxs observed, spike in RL rejects. Paging oncall.
Maya (oncall): On it. Seeing sustained QPS jump from 120 -> 1800 for the last 7m. 503s and token timeouts increasing.
Sam (sre): Confirmed. Dash: backend success rate down to 82%. KV cache pressure high. Suggest temporary org-level QPS bump + enable prefix caching for this org.
Jordan (eng): If we bump, prefer to push to dedicated GPU pool 2 (dedicated-pool-b). We can also route low-priority requests to smaller model to reduce CPU.
Maya (oncall): I'll do the QPS bump now and route fallback for non-critical routes. Sam, can you run the command? I'll coordinate comms.
Sam (sre): Running: `redwoodctl orgs update-quota --org org_4632 --qps 3000 --burst 5000 --reason "emergency spike - SilverStream"`  
ops-bot: Executing quota update...  
ops-bot: ✅ Quota updated for org_4632: QPS=3000, burst=5000 (change_id: ch_7521)
Maya (oncall): Routing change: `trafficctl set-route --org org_4632 --fallback-model rlm-small --percent 35`  
ops-bot: Route updated: 35% of inference routed to rlm-small for org_4632. (route_id: rt_998)
Tyler_CSM: FYI I DM'd SilverStream (account lead) and told them we're applying temporary capacity and will follow up with timeline. They reported visible failures in dashboard.
Elaine (support): Customer support ticket #45321 has been updated with incident note and ETA for rollback.
Sam (sre): Metrics: 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 3.1% over 90s, p50 latency improved 1.2s -> 480ms. Looks stable so far. :thumbsup:
Jordan (eng): Leaving canary in place. We'll monitor tail latency and KV miss rate. If stable for 15m, plan to scale down routing to 10% and drop extra quota.
Maya (oncall): Adding follow-up tasks: create postmortem, capture trigger (unexpected client-side retry storm), and add preventions (per-tenant circuit breaker). Assigning to Sam+Jordan.
Sam (sre): Noted. I'll attach graphs and the redwoodctl audit for ch_7521.
Tyler_CSM: I'll schedule a customer post-incident note and proposed SLA credit if needed.
Maya (oncall): Closing pager for now. Oncall remains watching. Will update thread on rollback schedule. Thanks everyone.
incident-bot: Pager resolved (incident-id: inc_2026)."
